_comment: Edge functions that build a service-role client and verify no caller. TRIAGE, not a vulnerability list - some are public by design. Each needs its callers enumerated before being guarded. This list must only ever shrink. See scripts/check-edge-auth.mjs.

notes.log-content-metrics: PUBLIC BY DESIGN - anonymous visitors report Core Web Vitals, so a guard would delete the feature. Bounded by a rate limit instead; its own header explains this. Do not guard.
notes.og-image: PUBLIC BY DESIGN - renders the social card any crawler fetches.
notes.check-login-attempt: Sends mail via Resend (RESEND_API_KEY, resend.com). Reachable with the anon key. Enumerate callers before guarding - it is on the sign-in path.
notes.check-core-web-vitals: Calls the Google PageSpeed Insights API (quota).
notes.subscription-lifecycle: Reaches a paid API directly; also 404 in production (never deployed).
notes.gsc-fetch-properties: Google API. 404 in production - never deployed.
notes.gsc-sync-data: Google API. 404 in production - never deployed.
notes.analyze-content: Writes the DB; no paid call detected.
notes.analyze-images: Writes the DB; no paid call detected.
notes.crawl-site: Writes the DB; no paid call detected. Targets seo_* tables that do not exist (WEB-BE-031), so likely inert.
notes.generate-hotel-affiliate-urls: Writes the DB; no paid call detected.
notes.pseo-batch-worker: Writes the DB; no paid call detected.
notes.oauth-callback: Read-only; no paid call detected. Part of an OAuth flow - check the state/code handling before assuming a guard is right.
